reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from this channel's own history, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Pree posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots during the carrier API outage, and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She later reported that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The messages only call the site "Southgate," with no street address. I also found no Tansley Parcel account folder in the shared files to add more detail. I told Tobias both of these things in the reply.
